T: Too old for this? Not for dessert.
D: A reckless LA cop is partnered with a family man about to turn fifty.
P: Serve the mains at Roger's birthday dinner, when Riggs meets the family.
S: Soft milk rolls: bread flour, milk, butter, sugar, yeast and an egg, proved twice, baked at 190C for 18 minutes, brushed with butter.
crackers and whatever's left in his fridge
Saltine crackers with slabs of sharp cheddar, folded salami and pickled jalapeños, served straight off a chopping board.
Warm crab and cream cheese dip with a cheddar crust, scooped up with crackers. Mix 250g cream cheese, 150g sour cream, 2 tsp Worcestershire and a squeeze of lemon.
M: the family jokes about her cooking, make yours better
Beef chuck browned in batches, onion, carrot, celery and tomato paste, deglazed with red wine, stock and thyme, braised at 150C for 3 hours. Mash.
Turkey breast brined overnight, roasted at 170C to 70C, rested. Cornbread stuffing, pan gravy and roast sweet potato.

edition.tagline: Too old for this? Not for dessert.
edition.cue: Serve the mains at Roger's birthday dinner, when Riggs meets the family.

s.note: crackers and whatever's left in his fridge
s.how: Cut 250g sharp cheddar into slabs and fold 150g sliced salami into quarters. Lay out on a chopping board with a sleeve of saltine crackers and a small bowl of pickled jalapeños. Eat it straight off the board on the couch.

Mix 250g cream cheese, 150g sour cream, 2 tsp Worcestershire and a squeeze of lemon. Fold in 200g crab meat and half the 100g grated cheddar, top with the rest and bake at 190C for 20 minutes until bubbling. Serve with 200g crackers.

m.note: the family jokes about her cooking, make yours better
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 1 onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks, stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, then add 250ml red wine, 500ml stock and thyme. Braise at 150C for 3 hours. Serve on 1kg potatoes mashed with butter.

w.note: fifty candles, he's too old for this
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in two tins at 170C for 35 minutes. Beat 200g butter, 300g icing sugar and 40g cocoa for buttercream. Fill, cover and add candles.

d.note: shared with the dog on the beach
d.how: Chill eight 375ml bottles of lager in the fridge for at least three hours, or in a bucket of ice and water for 30 minutes. Hand them out with the caps already off and drink straight from the bottle.
